ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Единение» (edinenie) is 'union', as in the week's Schopenhauer reading, and «разум» (razum) is 'reason' throughout; Pascal's generic «человек» (chelovek) is 'man', with he/his. The attribution is printed as «Паркер» (Parker), surname only, and is not expanded to Theodore Parker; the unquoted paragraph after it is kept unquoted and unattributed as in the source.

Source observation: [20] The unquoted paragraph «Разве люди боятся, чтобы горы провалились?…» follows the Parker attribution yet reads as a continuation of Parker's argument about church tradition; the attribution may be misplaced or the quote markup lost. Translated as printed (unquoted, after the attribution).
